WITH q AS (SELECT oq.*,v.telegram_chat_id,v.email_address FROM outbound_queue oq JOIN vendor v ON v.id=oq.vendor_id WHERE oq.id={{ Number($json.queue_id||0) }}), marked AS (UPDATE outbound_queue oq SET status='sending' FROM q WHERE oq.id=q.id AND oq.status IN('approved','partially_sent','failed') RETURNING oq.id)
SELECT q.id queue_id,q.turn_id,q.stage_id,q.vendor_id,q.approved_text delivery_body,q.email_subject,
 q.telegram_chat_id telegram_destination,q.email_address email_destination,
 COALESCE((SELECT status FROM outbound_delivery WHERE outbound_queue_id=q.id AND channel='email'),'missing') email_status,
 COALESCE((SELECT status FROM outbound_delivery WHERE outbound_queue_id=q.id AND channel='telegram'),'missing') telegram_status,
 'stage5-manager-chat-id-missing'::text manager_chat_id
FROM q;

WITH states AS (SELECT d.outbound_queue_id,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='sent') sent_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='failed') failed_count,max(sent_at) sent_at,string_agg(last_error,'; ') FILTER(WHERE status='failed') errors FROM outbound_delivery d WHERE d.outbound_queue_id={{ Number($json.queue_id||0) }} GROUP BY d.outbound_queue_id), updated AS (UPDATE outbound_queue q SET status=CASE WHEN s.sent_count=2 THEN 'sent' WHEN s.sent_count>0 AND s.failed_count>0 THEN 'partially_sent' WHEN s.failed_count=2 THEN 'failed' ELSE q.status END,sent_at=CASE WHEN s.sent_count=2 THEN s.sent_at ELSE q.sent_at END FROM states s WHERE q.id=s.outbound_queue_id RETURNING q.*,s.sent_count,s.failed_count,s.errors), activate AS (UPDATE turn_stage ts SET status='active',activated_at=COALESCE(ts.activated_at,now()) FROM updated u WHERE ts.id=u.stage_id AND u.sent_count>0 AND ts.status IN('awaiting_approval','awaiting_delivery') RETURNING ts.id), communications AS (INSERT INTO communication_message(direction,channel,vendor_id,turn_id,stage_id,outbound_queue_id,provider_message_id,recipient_ref,subject,body_text,normalized_text,status,sent_at) SELECT 'outbound',d.channel,u.vendor_id,u.turn_id,u.stage_id,u.id,d.provider_message_id,d.destination,d.subject,d.body_text,d.body_text,'sent',d.sent_at FROM updated u JOIN outbound_delivery d ON d.outbound_queue_id=u.id AND d.status='sent' ON CONFLICT(channel,provider_message_id) WHERE provider_message_id IS NOT NULL AND provider_message_id<>'' DO NOTHING RETURNING id), events AS (INSERT INTO event_log(turn_id,stage_id,actor_type,actor_id,channel,event_type,raw_text,parsed_json) SELECT u.turn_id,u.stage_id,'system','delivery-dispatcher','system',CASE WHEN u.status='sent' THEN 'delivery_sent' ELSE 'delivery_failed' END,COALESCE(u.errors,u.approved_text),jsonb_build_object('queue_id',u.id,'status',u.status,'sent_count',u.sent_count,'failed_count',u.failed_count) FROM updated u RETURNING id)
SELECT u.id queue_id,u.status outcome,u.sent_count,u.failed_count,u.errors,u.status IN('partially_sent','failed') should_alert_manager,'stage5-manager-chat-id-missing'::text manager_chat_id,CASE WHEN u.status='partially_sent' THEN 'Vendor delivery was partially sent. The successful channel will not be repeated. Use Retry on the failed channel.' WHEN u.status='failed' THEN 'Vendor delivery failed on both channels. Review the errors and retry.' END manager_notice_text FROM updated u;
